card.name: Chapter-verse numbers in Latter-day Saint scripture citations
card.fires_on: The colon or digits of a chapter:verse reference right after a Book of Mormon, Doctrine and Covenants, or Pearl of Great Price book name, such as 2 Nephi, Ether, Alma or Moses.

modes.label: Colon after chapter
modes.description: The colon between chapter and verse after a Book of Mormon book name and chapter number.

modes.label: Digits inside reference
modes.description: Chapter or verse digits within a list of scripture citations.

card.writes: It suppresses Latter-day Saint terms such as Latter, Salt, LDS, Stake, Elder and Brigham, so it lowers church-related words after a scripture citation.
card.plain: It marks numbers and colons inside Book of Mormon style scripture references, where church names are less likely to come next.
